description: A line comment inside a for expression is ignored like a newline
notes: The Collection Values section says newlines are ignored between the delimiters of "these sequences", which refers to the tuple and object productions. ForExpr is a separate production whose grammar has no Newline, and the spec repeats the newline rule for parentheses, function call arguments and index brackets but never for for expressions. hashicorp/hcl ignores newlines everywhere inside a for expression: finishParsingForExpr in hclsyntax/parser.go calls PushIncludeNewlines(false). A line comment counts as a newline.
